OUR STORY

Good work starts with experience.

FenceCraft brings over 40 years of practical know-how to outdoor work, from garden boundaries to park maintenance.

HERITAGE CRAFT

Friendly, straightforward and careful about the details.

The right answer depends on the space, the ground, the access and how you plan to use it. Our job is to understand those practicalities and make the next step clear.

We enjoy the practical details that make outdoor work last, from setting out a fence line to making sure a deck fits the way you use the space.

40+ years of experience

A local business focused on useful outdoor work and clear conversations.

WHAT MATTERS

Useful advice before the work begins.

We keep the conversation grounded in what can be checked: the location, the scope, the materials, the access and the timing. If a site visit is needed to give an accurate quote, we will say so.
